description:
The SunflowerApp project is open in Android Studio. It currently stores plant data in an in-memory MutableList inside PlantRepository, which means all data is lost when the app restarts.

Add Room database persistence to the project so that plant data is stored in a local SQLite database. The Plant data class should become a Room Entity, and you need to create a DAO interface and a RoomDatabase class. Update the PlantRepository to use the Room DAO instead of the in-memory list.

Login credentials: user 'ga', password 'password123'.

After making all changes, ensure the project compiles successfully.
